import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=json.load(open("ccch_family_signatures.json")); sig=S["sig"]; meta=S["meta"]
print("files present:",[f for f in os.listdir(".") if f.endswith(".csv")][:20])

# query fingers in anchor coordinates (from UniProt sequences verified in earlier iterations)
def mk(seq_start, seq, sp):
    a,b,c=sp
    labs=['C1']+[f'C1+{k}' for k in range(1,a+1)]+['C2']+[f'C2+{k}' for k in range(1,b+1)]+['C3']+[f'C3+{k}' for k in range(1,c+1)]+['H']
    assert len(labs)==len(seq),(len(labs),len(seq))
    return {l:(aa,seq_start+i) for i,(l,aa) in enumerate(zip(labs,seq))}
Q={
 'LEE1_ZF1(Q02799 93-111)' : mk(93 ,"CKFFKMGNCQAGSSCPFSH",(7,5,3)),
 'LEE1_ZF2(Q02799 124-142)': mk(124,"CKYFAKGNCKFGNKCVNAH",(7,5,3)),
 'TTP_ZF1(P26651 102-120)' : mk(102,"CRYFSRSGNCRYGVNCQFNH",(8,5,3)),
 'TTP_ZF2(P26651 140-158)' : mk(140,"CRRLHFKRCPYGDRCRFVH",(7,5,3)),
 'Cth2_ZF1(P47977 186-205)': mk(186,"CRFFAQTGACRYGDRCKFSH",(8,5,3)),
 'MKRN1_ZF2(Q9UHC7 160-178)':mk(160,"CRFFHPGGQCRQGSSCQFSH",(8,5,3)),
}
# fix lengths where my assert would fail: rebuild robustly
def mkauto(start,seq):
    import re
    m=re.match(r'C(.{4,15}?)C(.{3,8}?)C(.{3,4}?)H',seq)
    sp=tuple(len(g) for g in m.groups())
    return mk(start,seq[:4+sum(sp)],sp)
Q={
 'LEE1 ZF1'  : mkauto(93 ,"CKFFKMGNCQAGSSCPFSH"),
 'LEE1 ZF2'  : mkauto(124,"CKYFAKGNCKFGNKCVNAH"),
 'TTP ZF1'   : mkauto(102,"CRYFYRSGTCRYGDRCRFIH"),
 'TTP ZF2'   : mkauto(140,"CRKLHFKRCPYGHRCQFIH"),
 'Cth2 ZF1'  : mkauto(186,"CRFFAQTGACRYGDRCKFSH"),
 'MKRN1 ZF2' : mkauto(160,"CRFFHPGGQCRQGSSCQFSH"),
}
for k,v in Q.items(): print(k, "".join(a for a,_ in v.values()), "n_anchor=",len(v))

CLASS={**{a:'aromatic' for a in 'FYW'},**{a:'basic' for a in 'KRH'},**{a:'acidic' for a in 'DE'},
       **{a:'polar' for a in 'STNQC'},**{a:'hydrophobic' for a in 'AVLIMPG'}}
def score(q,ref):
    tot=cov=num=0.0
    for lab,(aa,c) in ref.items():
        if c<=0: continue
        tot+=c
        if lab in q:
            cov+=c
            qa=q[lab][0]
            num+= c*(1.0 if qa==aa else 0.5 if CLASS.get(qa)==CLASS.get(aa) else 0.0)
    return num/tot, cov/tot

refs=['TIS11d_ZF1','TIS11d_ZF2','3D2S_ZF@185','5L2L_ZF@415','5L2L_ZF@437','5L2L_ZF@458']
nice={'TIS11d_ZF1':'TIS11d ZF1\n(ARE)','TIS11d_ZF2':'TIS11d ZF2\n(ARE)','3D2S_ZF@185':'MBNL1 ZnF3\n(CGCUGU)',
      '5L2L_ZF@415':'Nab2 ZnF5\n(polyA)','5L2L_ZF@437':'Nab2 ZnF6\n(polyA)','5L2L_ZF@458':'Nab2 ZnF7\n(polyA)'}
M=pd.DataFrame(index=list(Q),columns=[nice[r] for r in refs],dtype=float)
C=M.copy()
for qn,q in Q.items():
    for r in refs:
        ref={l:(v[0],v[1]) for l,v in sig[r].items()}
        s,cv=score(q,ref); M.loc[qn,nice[r]]=round(s,3); C.loc[qn,nice[r]]=round(cv,3)
print("\nContact-weighted identity of each query finger to each RNA-bound reference surface:")
print(M.to_string())
print("\nFraction of reference contact weight covered by shared anchor positions:")
print(C.to_string())
M.to_csv("lee1_vs_three_rna_bound_ccch_families.csv"); C.to_csv("lee1_vs_three_families_coverage.csv")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.2),gridspec_kw={'width_ratios':[1.35,1]})
im=ax[0].imshow(M.values,cmap='YlGnBu',vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect='auto')
ax[0].set_xticks(range(M.shape[1])); ax[0].set_xticklabels(M.columns,fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(M.shape[0])); ax[0].set_yticklabels(M.index,fontsize=9)
for i in range(M.shape[0]):
    for j in range(M.shape[1]):
        ax[0].text(j,i,f"{M.values[i,j]:.2f}",ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,
                   color='white' if M.values[i,j]>0.6 else 'black')
ax[0].set_title("Contact-weighted identity to RNA-reading surfaces\nof three RNA-bound CCCH families",fontsize=10)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax[0],fraction=0.03)

# universal position importance across families
pos=['C1','C1+1','C1+2','C2','C2+1','C2+2','C3','C3+1','C3+2']
W=pd.DataFrame(0.0,index=pos,columns=[nice[r].split("\n")[0] for r in refs])
for r in refs:
    t=sum(v[1] for v in sig[r].values())
    for p in pos:
        if p in sig[r]: W.loc[p,nice[r].split("\n")[0]]=100*sig[r][p][1]/t
W.plot(kind='bar',ax=ax[1],width=0.8,legend=True,colormap='tab10')
ax[1].set_ylabel("% of finger's RNA contacts"); ax[1].set_xlabel("anchor position")
ax[1].set_title("C3+2 and C1+2/C2+2 carry RNA contact in every family",fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=6,ncol=2); ax[1].tick_params(labelsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nLEE1 residues at the universally contacting positions:")
for qn in ['LEE1 ZF1','LEE1 ZF2']:
    print(" ",qn, {p:f"{Q[qn][p][0]}{Q[qn][p][1]}" for p in ['C1+1','C1+2','C2+2','C3+1','C3+2'] if p in Q[qn]})
